answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake of jade-backed credits before it can trade, like a pearl that only forms under pressure. New identities start with a whisper of trust — a tiny reputation budget that grows only through verified, useful work attested by established peers. Creating thousands of fake agents would cost a fortune in locked stake, while honest agents earn their deposit back plus rewards, making mass fakery unprofitable.
